$comment: Single source of truth for the ResearchOS module graph. scripts/generate-workspaces.mjs generates package manifests + tsconfig references from this file; scripts/lint-architecture.mjs enforces it. Adding a dependency here is a deliberate architectural act.

layers.0: foundation      - no ResearchOS dependencies at all
layers.1: contracts       - schemas every boundary agrees on
layers.3: ports+adapters  - replaceable infrastructure and pure domain primitives
layers.4: domain services - logic composed from layer 3
layers.6: composition     - the research engine wiring everything

shared.description: IDs, errors, Result, clock, config, retry, assertions.

contracts.description: Domain model, event, agent and API schemas. The stable surface every client codes against.

sdk.description: TypeScript client for the ResearchOS API (REST + SSE).

observability.description: Structured logging, traces, metrics, token/cost accounting.

events.description: Domain event bus port + in-memory adapter.

persistence.description: SQL dialects, migrations, repositories. SQLite + Postgres adapters.

model-router.description: ModelProvider port, provider adapters, policy-driven router.

tools.description: ResearchTool port, permission-aware registry, built-in tools.

evidence.description: Source quality rubric, evidence strength, independence discounting.

knowledge-graph.description: Research graph store port, traversal, research tree projection.

experiments.description: Experiment runner port and local process adapter.

claims.description: Claim aggregation, log-odds confidence, contradiction detection.

retrieval.description: Hybrid lexical + semantic retrieval over evidence memory.

ingestion.description: Fetch, parse, normalise and chunk sources into evidence-ready documents.

executors.description: External executor protocol. How Echo attaches without code coupling.

verification.description: Citation, arithmetic, consistency and reproducibility checks.

evaluation.description: Rubric-scored assessment of a completed research project. Pure: no models, no I/O.

orchestration.description: Durable task queue, leases, retries, budgets, resumable runs.

research-core.description: Agents, task handlers, debate engine, report builder.

api.description: HTTP API + SSE stream. The only network surface.

forbiddenIdentifiers.$comment: Product names must never leak into the reusable core. Echo and Aira are clients, not dependencies.
